currentWeather.description: Real-time observation data including MSLP, wind direction/speed, temp, weather code, cloud cover, humidity, 24h rainfall

cityForecast.description: 7-day medium range city weather forecast including min/max temp and weather description

cityForecastLocation.description: 7-day city weather forecast with station latitude, longitude, and elevation coordinates

districtNowcast.description: Severe weather nowcast (3-hour validity) for districts with warning colors and meteorological descriptions

districtRainfall.description: District-level cumulative daily and seasonal rainfall telemetry with IMD category codes (LE, E, N, D, LD, NR, ND)

districtWarning.description: Multi-hazard district-level 5-day warning matrix with hazard codes (Heavy Rain, Squall, Heat Wave, etc.)

stationNowcast.description: Station-specific thunderstorm, gust, and convective nowcasting alerts

stateRainfall.description: State-level cumulative rainfall statistics and departure percentages

awsData.description: Surface telemetry from Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) & Automated Rain Gauges (ARG)

awsMapping.description: Registry of operational Automatic Weather Stations across India

basinQPF.description: Quantitative Precipitation Forecast (QPF) for major Indian river sub-basins

portWarning.description: Marine port warning signals and gale advisories for Indian sea ports

seaBulletin.description: Sea area meteorological bulletins for Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean

coastalBulletin.description: Coastal weather bulletin for maritime fishing operations and coastal craft

subdivisionWarning.description: Synoptic meteorological warnings across all 36 meteorological subdivisions of India

sunMoon.description: Solar and lunar ephemeris (Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise, Moonset) in IST

stateDistrictRainfallForecast.description: State and district level quantitative precipitation forecasts

cycloneTrack.description: Observed and forecasted tropical cyclonic storm tracks with coordinates and intensity

cycloneWind.description: Gale wind speed hazard radius and quadrants (28kt, 34kt, 50kt, 64kt)

cycloneCone.description: Cone of Uncertainty polygon coordinates for active tropical storms
